title: What If You Tried to Land on Neptune?

scenes.text: What if you tried to land on Neptune? There is no ground, only wind.
Neptune has no solid surface. Its atmosphere sinks into water and melted ices, over a core about Earth's mass.
Winds reach over 1,200 miles an hour, roughly five times Earth's strongest, which are about 250.
Sunlight takes about four hours to arrive, from thirty times Earth's distance from the Sun.
One Neptune year lasts about 165 Earth years. It finished its first orbit since discovery only in 2011.
In 1989, Voyager 2 saw a storm big enough to hold all of Earth. It has since vanished.

description:
